rootCause: Canvas stroke dash arrays/offsets did not use the element pathLength or current geometric length. Every number was treated as an uncalibrated user-space length.
change: Measure complete local geometry including closure, independent subpaths, cubic/quadratic curves and analytical elliptical arcs. Apply author-length ratio to dash arrays/offsets only. Cache static lengths with viewport geometry; rebuild for animated attributes. Zero resets to Chrome-compatible solid strokes. Parent/use attributes do not leak into shape calibration. New length evaluation is limited to262144 segment/sample operations per frame; an actual6000-cusp component input reports failure and the next valid source renders exactly.

construction.description: 60 deterministic complete SVGs:15 geometries x2 author lengths plus units/odd lists/zero controls/malformed attrs/nested/use/transforms/animated length and endpoint frames.
construction.oracle: Native Chrome SVG originals are the primary visible-content oracle. Independently rewritten no-pathLength SVGs using native getTotalLength are secondary evidence, not silently substituted for originals.
construction.numerical: 11 independent analytic or NumPy Gauss-Legendre length goldens, including reversal cusp, eccentric ellipse and closed subpaths. Relative1e-7 length tolerance is numerical integration accuracy, not a raster pass threshold.
